paper.title: Incorporating Behavioral Constraints in Online AI Systems

unmapped: Disjoint linear contextual model: each arm k has its own unknown weight vector mu_k with E[r_k(t)|c(t)] = mu_k^T c(t)
A preliminary constraint-learning phase of N rounds in which a teacher reveals binary constraint feedback r^e_k(t); no constraint feedback during the online phase
Behavioral constraints learned from examples; blending weight sigma_online between constrained and reward-driven policies
How contexts are generated is not specified
settings.definition_quote: At each time $t \in \{1,...,T\}$, a player is presented with a {\em context vector} $c(t) \in \mathbf{R}^d$ and must choose an arm $k \in K$ ... $r_k(t) \in [0,1]$ ... $E[r_k(t)|c(t)] = \mu_k^T c(t)$ ... In this setting, the agent first goes through a {\em constraint learning phase} where it is allowed to query the user $N$ times and receive feedback $r^e_k(t) \in [0,1]$ about whether or not the chosen decision is allowed

symbols.sigma_online: blending weight in [0,1] between reward-driven and constrained policy
symbols.mu_norm: ||mu*_max + mu^e_min||_2, with mu*_max = max_k ||mu*_k||_1 and mu^e = learned constrained policy

conditions: regret measured against Definition 1 optimal (reward-driven) policy

source.label: thm:upperbcts
source.quote: Consider the BCTS algorithm with $K$ arms, $d$ features, and take $0 \leq \blend \leq 1$ and $0 \leq \gamma \leq 1$. Then, with probability $(1-\gamma)$, the upper bound on the regret R(T) at time $T$ is: \blend \frac{d\gamma}{z} \sqrt{T^{z+1}} (ln (T) d) ln \frac{1}{\gamma}+ (1-\blend) c_{max} T ||\tilde{\mu}^*_{max}+\mu^{e}_{min}||_2

results.notes: Paper's gamma is the failure probability (mapped to delta); bound as printed contains a gamma factor. Statement writes mu^e_min while the definition and proof use mu^e_max; recorded as in theorem. Bound is linear in T when sigma_online<1. Regret notion loosely defined.

symbols.N_teach: number of teacher queries in the constraint learning phase

conditions: regret measured against Definition 2 optimal BCCB policy (blend of optimal reward and constraint policies)
CTS used in the constraint learning phase

source.label: thm:upperCBTS
source.quote: Using Definition 2 of optimal policy we have, with probability $(1-\gamma)$, the upper bound on the regret R(T) at time $T$ is: max(\blend^*,\blend)\frac{d\gamma}{z} \sqrt{T^{z+1}} (ln (T) d) ln \frac{1}{\gamma}+max((1-\blend^*),(1-\blend))\frac{d\gamma}{z} \sqrt{N^{z+1}} (ln (N) d) ln \frac{1}{\gamma}

results.notes: Comparator is the Definition 2 blended optimal policy, mapped to best_policy. Paper's N (teacher queries) declared as N_teach to avoid conflict with canonical N. gamma mapped to delta.
